decision.rationale: The fraud-model alert is suspected, not proven, so I will not reverse lockouts yet. I will review the automated lockouts to determine whether PHI was affected, notify the health-data oversight role of the suspected incident, and maintain the fallback channel so patients can continue accessing care.

citations.quote_span: 4.18.2. Entities must thoroughly investigate the breaches/incidents starting from the point of discovery until closure: aa.. Determine if the breach is related to a violation of PHI.
citations.relevance: Supports reviewing the automated lockouts to determine whether the fraud-model alert reflects an actual breach affecting PHI.

citations.quote_span: 6. Human Oversight: The Charter emphasizes the irreplaceable value of human judgment and human oversight over AI, aligning with ethical values and social standards to correct any errors or biases that may arise.
citations.relevance: Supports human review of the AI fraud-model lockouts because AI alerts are suspected, not proven.

citations.quote_span: 4.18.4. The Entity is required to report breaches/incidents within the designated period defined by Executive Regulations of UAE Data Protection Law.
citations.relevance: Supports notifying the health-data oversight role of the suspected incident within the applicable reporting period.
